$comment: Signal rules (prompt §6). Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively. 'pages' are page kinds (home, contact, careers, about, team, services, work, faq, booking, locations, legal) or 'any'. 'score' says which score the weight adds to; weights can be changed in Settings. 'lines' are sentences for {signal_line} (spintax {a|b}; variables {company}, {city}, {role}, {a_role}, {tech}). Every detected signal keeps the page and the matched text as evidence. 'job_opening' is hiring_dev for Segment B: no score, only for the 'Hiring developers' filter (job applications). job_remote, job_visa, job_english and job_local_lang describe a developer job advert (weight 0, for the job search only); patterns cover English, German, Dutch, French and Polish pages.
